data.name: Earthshot Labs
data.description: Earthshot Labs is a US-based nature-based carbon project developer and technology platform that helps land stewards develop reforestation (ARR), REDD+, and improved forest management projects globally. The company operates LandOS for project feasibility and MRV, has developed 60+ projects, and raised a $5.5M Series A in 2024. It also operates its own reforestation project in Panama.
